_readme: LOCAL STUB DATA SOURCE for scripts/sync-inbox.mjs. Replace with a real query against Supabase once the admin board can post comments — see the TODO in sync-inbox.mjs. Shape: see docs/README-DOCS.md section 7. Do not hand-edit docs/INBOX.md; edit this file and re-run the script.

_schema.doc: the id of the doc this comment is on (PRD-001, ADR-001, DOC-004, ...)
_schema.author: who wrote it
_schema.resolution: null while unresolved; otherwise { note, link, resolved, by }

comments.author: james
comments.body: The vote-count ceiling is too low. Top tier is >=10 votes, so a tag with 10 votes and one with 500 render identically. Propose adding a level 0 for >=50, or showing the raw number once a tag passes some threshold.

comments.author: james
comments.body: What is /restaurants1 actually for? If it is dead, it should be removed before the module extraction in ADR-001 rather than carried across.

comments.author: james
comments.body: Should machine-seeded tags count as votes? They currently land in the same table with user_id NULL and no read query filters on source.

comments.author: james
comments.body: The 'deliberately excluded' list in the launch spec is still empty. Only I can fill that in - the code cannot tell the difference between 'decided against' and 'never got to'.

comments.author: james
comments.body: The glossary entry for 'level' says it is a raw count, but the web client treats it as a 1-5 tier. One of these is wrong.

resolution.note: Both were right - the word means different things on each side of the API. Glossary entry rewritten to name the collision explicitly.
